main_text.p: Hinc Galatas nostros spectaui, & inhospita Ponti Littora lustraui trepidans, equitésque Bithynos, Persarúmque diu rubuit qui strage cruentus Granico, & Xerxi quondã æquora strata superbo, Et campos ubi Troia fuit, Xantiquesluenta, Exigua illa quidem, magno sed maxima Vati: Hellas vbi est Asia lento collisa duello.
Ionium hinc littus, magna & delubra Diana Inspexi, famæ cupido succensa latroni.

Æolis hinc spectata mihi, & quas Hermus arenas Aurifer, & Lesbi soluit Pactolus in æquor: Quíque recuruatis ludit Maander in Vndis, Venalesque Cares animæ: & post Doridos isthmu, Clara Rhodos, Lyciaque quidquid cõpletitur ora, Pamphylíq deinceps montes, Cilicúmque beata Messes, & latrociniis infamis Isaurus.

Inde mihi portas rigidus patefecit Amanus. Venimus hinc Issum Persarũ strage madentem: Inde canas Syria Valles, camposque beatos, Et gemini cedros Libani, priscámque Damascu, Et, Cypro oppositum qui fertur in æquor Orontem, Sidona hinc, Versámque Tyri deuenimus oram, Et claras Iordanis aquas, infamia donec Stagna petens fœdo totum se sulphure condat.
Balsama quinetiam miris Ierichuntis in hortis Vidimus, & sanctas Solymorũ ascendimus arces, Templa meo male nota duci: & saxosus Idumes Quidquid ager nutrit, Nabathaáque pascua quidquid.

page.notes: Printed text is in a Latin verse set in long lines; the marginal and italic-free layout is as printed. Some words are uncertain: "Xantiquesluenta" (Xanthique fluenta), "Versámque" and "cõpletitur" are copied as printed; "Maander" and "Lesbi" as printed. Nothing is illegible.
